t: On the wall near the Silk Street entrance to the Barbican Centre, you're looking at the Barbican Muse, a sculpture of a woman holding the masks of tragedy and comedy. It was installed here in 1994. The masks suit a place built for the performing arts. The sculptor is Matthew Spender, an English sculptor and painter who was also a writer. He made this piece, so what you see is his work, set into the wall of the Barbican.
